evidence.r1: Glass only on the Before/After toggle (top of stage), tool palette (right), rating bar (bottom) and the crop platter; all controls, light and dark.
evidence.r2: Selected 'After' pill, the 3:2 chip, the slider cards and Reset/Done inside the crop platter are fills, not stacked glass (menu, both schemes).
evidence.r3: Three glass elements at rest (compare toggle, tool palette, rating bar), each doing one job the brief asks for.
evidence.r4: Toggle, palette, rating bar and crop platter share one frosted regular material in light and dark.
evidence.r5: No clear variant anywhere; every surface blurs the photograph beneath it.
evidence.r6: No control is tinted; the palette's pink/blue is refraction of the glove and jeans behind it (light).
evidence.r7: Control bodies carry the blurred photo through them; they turn opaque only under the reduce-transparency switch.
evidence.r8: Capsule toggle, palette and rating bar; fixed-radius crop platter, cards and buttons.
evidence.r9: 'After' pill is concentric in its capsule; the crop platter's inner cards and Reset/Done sit close to concentric with its corners, nothing pinched (menu light).
evidence.r10: Floating toggle, palette and rating bar are capsules; the dense ratio chips and Reset/Done are small rounded rectangles.
evidence.r11: Rating bar groups reject | stars | flag on one glass with dividers; the three tools share the palette; the compare toggle stands alone.
evidence.r12: The open crop platter puts text buttons (3:2, 1:1, Reset, Done) on the same glass as the exposure, white-balance and crop icon buttons (menu, both schemes).
evidence.r13: Material sits on the containers; the chips, cards and selected crop button inside are fills.
evidence.r14: The three controls sit far apart on purpose, and the crop platter grows out of the palette as one shape.
evidence.r15: Nothing scrolls under a floating control: the page is one viewport and the filmstrip scrolls outside the glass. No edge effect is drawn, so the rule holds vacuously.
evidence.r16: All glass sits over the forge photograph.
evidence.r17: At rest the toggle, rating bar and palette sit on the photograph being culled (top, bottom and right of the stage).
evidence.r18: Before/After and crop labels are dark on light glass (~12:1, light) and white on dark glass (~11:1, dark).
evidence.r19: Reduced capture: controls turn opaque white with every label, icon and selection legible. Increased contrast and reduced motion were not captured.
evidence.r20: The photo is boxed in a stage between the left and right side panels and above the filmstrip, with grey margins; it does not reach the window edges.
evidence.r21: The stage ends at hard edges against both side panels, with no background extension (light and dark).
evidence.r22: No scrim, border or backing is added under the toggle, palette, rating bar or crop platter in either scheme.
evidence.r23: The crop platter grows out of the tool palette at its anchor (menu capture). Press feedback is not visible.
evidence.r24: Every icon and label on the glass is monochrome; the colour stays in the photograph.
evidence.r25: Dark and white labels separate cleanly from the dark forge photo behind; none takes its orange or blue.
